description: Image Description: The image depicts a large piece of street art on a concrete wall. The central focus of the mural is an oversized toaster, illustrated in a bold, graphic style with thick black outlines and shading. The toaster is painted on an orange background, which forms a vertical rectangle on the wall. Surrounding the large toaster are several smaller toasters painted in black and white, each placed on different sections of the wall.
